title: Video features
description: Encode appearance, motion, and local detail for downstream video tasks.

groups.title: Video encoders
groups.description: Shared text–video embeddings and visual features for retrieval, tracking, and understanding.

title: Retrieval and memory
description: Find recordings and events, retain their history, and answer questions over video.

groups.title: Find videos and moments
groups.description: Retrieve source videos, localize matching intervals, or find repeated events.

groups.title: Read a selected video
groups.description: Readers and benchmarks that start with the relevant recording already selected.

groups.title: Write and reuse memory
groups.description: Segment and describe events, retain useful records, and revisit frames when needed.

groups.title: Recall across sessions
groups.description: Multi-day and cross-session evaluation, with a survey of multimodal memory designs.

groups.title: Events, entities, and time
groups.description: Interaction records, contextual indices, and relational memory for connected events.

groups.title: Search with tools
groups.description: Controllers that refine retrieval and inspect additional visual evidence.

groups.title: Execute video queries
groups.description: Indexing, predicates, input filtering, configuration, and resource scheduling for repeated video workloads.

title: Linking observations
description: Connect viewpoints, people, objects, and places across separate observations.

groups.title: People and shared histories
groups.description: Identify whose experience is being described and combine observations from several people.

groups.title: Compare viewpoints
groups.description: Synchronize views, select complementary evidence, and relate demonstrations to execution.

groups.title: Locate objects over time
groups.description: Object-query benchmarks and memory of instances, locations, and user-relative space.

groups.title: Objects and scene relations
groups.description: Represent object identities, actions, attributes, and spatial relations, with benchmarks for localized scene understanding.

title: Grounded answers
description: Check which observations support an answer and when the system should abstain.

groups.title: Answers with evidence
groups.description: Temporal evidence for answers and source citations for reports over a video corpus.

groups.title: Bind facts to events
groups.description: Distinguish similar episodes and account for the time over which an observation remains valid.

groups.title: Answerability and abstention
groups.description: Recognize missing evidence, false premises, and the tradeoff between coverage and unsupported answers.

title: Object states
description: Track what changed in an object and distinguish observed state from progress toward a goal.

groups.title: Object transformations
groups.description: Localize, describe, segment, and track changes in objects during manipulation.

groups.title: State evidence
groups.description: Detailed observations, evolving object and event counts, temporal state questions, and comparison with a correct assembly reference.

groups.title: Progress toward a goal
groups.description: Relative progress, regression, and outcome scores, distinct from verified physical completion.

title: Procedures and errors
description: Recognize procedure steps, identify deviations, and reason about errors and recovery.

groups.title: Steps and dependencies
groups.description: Task graphs, step parsing, completion recognition, and questions about procedural structure.

groups.title: Execution benchmarks
groups.description: Recorded assembly, cooking, instruction, and collaborative tasks with procedure annotations.

groups.title: Detect execution errors
groups.description: Detect deviations from valid actions, expected effects, and procedural constraints.

groups.title: Explain errors and recovery
groups.description: Localize or explain mistakes using instructions, state observations, and completed step sequences.

groups.title: Recognize actions over time
groups.description: Pose-based action recognition and causal segmentation of procedural actions, distinct from judging execution correctness.

title: Streaming assistance
description: Maintain useful context and decide when to respond as observations arrive.

groups.title: Maintain streaming context
groups.description: Bounded memory and efficient reading of recent and accumulated video.

groups.title: Choose when to respond
groups.description: Protocols and methods for proactive notifications, event monitoring, and timely safety alerts.

groups.title: Feedback during execution
groups.description: Step-aware guidance and early error decisions under each paper’s observation protocol.

groups.title: Dialogue as video arrives
groups.description: Models that alternate observation, silence, and language responses while optimizing content and response timing.

groups.title: Describe events as they unfold
groups.description: Emit timestamped event descriptions using compressed history or a separate event-boundary detector.

title: Construction monitoring
description: Apply visual evidence and event records to site progress, requirements, and corrective work.

groups.title: Progress and acceptance
groups.description: Link observations to construction models, work quantities, accepted work, and event logs.

groups.title: Evidence and site checks
groups.description: Retrieve construction operations and inspect requirements, hazards, and corrective actions.

title: Workplace safety
description: Inspect protective equipment, identify rule violations, and evaluate actionable hazard warnings.

groups.title: Protective equipment checks
groups.description: Workplace image data and methods for PPE presence, equipment attributes, and harness anchoring states.

groups.title: Rules and hazard monitoring
groups.description: Construction and mining systems that combine observations with safety rules, reports, incident records, or human confirmation.

groups.title: Evaluate hazard warnings
groups.description: Actionable accident precursors and evidence for collision-monitoring capabilities, including timing and grounding.

title: Skill and anomaly assessment
description: Assess execution quality and unusual events under task-specific evaluation assumptions.

groups.title: Skill and feedback
groups.description: Relative proficiency, informative moments, and expert feedback from demonstrations.

groups.title: Video anomaly detection
groups.description: Surveillance anomaly detection and explanation, separate from procedure-specific correctness.

title: Reward and policy learning
description: Learn rewards from video, demonstrations, preferences, or corrections and use them to train behavior.

groups.title: Visual rewards for policies
groups.description: Goal-image and language-conditioned rewards, progress estimates, and rollout scores evaluated for policy learning.

groups.title: Preferences and corrections
groups.description: Human comparisons, criterion-specific preferences, and corrective interventions as supervision for behavior learning.
